environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64; Node 24.14.0; npm 11.9.0; TypeScript 5.9.3; Playwright 1.61.1
checks: Explicit source/sink selections resolve only matching semantics, schema revisions, permissions and compatible route value/delivery policies
Missing or wrong selections return structured issues with candidate device/capability alternatives; no implicit selection occurs
Processor ID/version/SHA-256 pin and configuration must match an installed inert manifest; wrong pin and malformed configuration reject
Environment getters are not invoked; deeper valid descriptor schemas remain accepted; read/property routes and processor routes are covered
Immutable-tree SDK installed offline in a clean external consumer; strict NodeNext/Bundler types and packed Node, Chromium, Firefox and WebKit checks pass
scope: E03 static recipe resolution against host-supplied descriptors and processor manifests. It returns an acyclic route plan and owner operation requests without loading processor code, choosing a device, granting access or starting a route. The host must verify installed code bytes, current readiness and consent in E04. Examples remain embedded simulations; no physical or remote service claim.
